versions.name: Engelstad Scout Park
versions.address: 7220 S Paradise Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89119
versions.summary: An urban Las Vegas Area Council activity park adjoining the council's Scouting Resource Center, hosting Cub Scout day camps, target and field sports, a climbing wall, and council-wide Scouting events and camporees.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from Las Vegas Area Council pages, which present Engelstad Scout Park at the council's Scouting Resource Center as an active site for Cub Scout day camps, a spring-break day camp, and conservation camporees. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own site; classified conservatively as a program center hosting day-camp and short-term programming; features unsurveyed.
